Definition: from G4253 and G1212; plain before all men, i.e. obvious:--evident, manifest (open) beforehand.
BiblicalUsage: Prodelos means plain before all, evident, manifest. Paul says some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment, and some men's good works are manifest beforehand. Hebrews says it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that nothing stays hidden for ever, and the evident things now are only the first showing of the judgment to come.
